summary:
Revised implementation plan addressing cross-device persistence across PCs without requiring user login accounts:
1. Explains and incorporates Firebase Firestore anonymous shared cloud state so any PC opening the app URL automatically shares and loads the wheels.
2. Includes a 1-click Portable JSON Backup/Restore feature for instant offline transport via USB or email.
3. Hybrid Word/Excel document analyzer (fast parser + Gemini 2.5 Flash classification) appending wheels.
4. Auto-hide presentation hover zones with 0.3s opacity transitions.
5. Sober navy-and-gold visual redesign of the top dropdown menu matching the Spelling Bee slide.
